sample_scope: Six named recordings, 6040 frames sampled at >=0.5 s; 24 automatic candidate windows; 11 reached the sampled far-heading criterion and were visually inspected.

reviewed_car_turns.mode: Forward, reversing turn, forward; first short L2 pulse brakes, second changes the turning direction with opposite lock.
Forward arc across an open junction; no L2.
Forward arc over an open median; no L2.

excluded_completed.0: Drives forward beside a rail; route changes, no turn.
excluded_completed.1: Drives forward; route changes, no turn.
excluded_completed.2: Drives forward past an open merge; no turn.
excluded_completed.3: Motorbike, not a car; 0.246 s L2 does not prove reverse.
excluded_completed.8: Rollover against a cliff, not a controlled turn.
excluded_completed.17: Motorbike; not included in car-turn count.
excluded_completed.19: Collision recovery beside a lorry; 6.044 s L2, not a clean route turn.
excluded_completed.20: Ordinary junction turn with 1.006 s braking; no reversing turn proved.

limitations: Small selected sample, not a population rate. Sampled heading-window durations are not exact movement durations; camera changes and reroutes can satisfy the numerical criterion without a turn. L2 command duration includes braking and input-to-picture delay.
